No row filtering, shape-based authority, sign conversion, canonicalization or malformed-value admission was added.

Helpers receive distinct SQL/destination components; Project_Alternatives receives Arena input-only and Good as the only scalar in-out state. Root/Subject out formals are fully assigned over their existing bounds. The only new Old reference is scalar Good, not the arena/owner.

Initialization, counts/status checks, append order, Good propagation, event extras, symbol interning and final Parsed_Spans_Valid/N.Valid guard remain in the same order. Failed SQL cells retain their existing initialized forms. Parsed remains decoding only: actual fold, row/schema checks, source/owner custody and operation authority remain in unchanged downstream callers. Global=null and finite loops are consistent with bodies. Present postconditions for roots/subjects reflect unconditional row assignment; Good postcondition accurately preserves false. No assumption, imported theorem, exception suppression, source/proof scope reduction or public contract weakening appears. Project_Events has no formal frame/functional postcondition; its exact bounded assignments were reviewed, and complete semantic equivalence is not claimed as a formal theorem.
